faq.title: What to know before you start
faq.q1: What exactly am I paying for?
faq.a1: Choose a monthly platform plan for capabilities and a separate monthly inbound-minute bundle. Outbound conversation time is billed separately at 1.40 GEL per minute after the customer answers.
faq.q2: Are inbound and outbound calls included in one bundle?
faq.a2: No. Inbound bundles cover inbound calls only. Outbound usage is billed separately.
faq.q3: How is inbound call pricing calculated?
faq.a3: Inbound conversation time is displayed at an indicative 0.54 GEL per minute after aiCALL answers, so 10 minutes are approximately 5.40 GEL. You pay for the selected monthly bundle. An additional bundle activates only after your approval.
faq.a4: Custom starts at 5,000 GEL per month for the platform, but capacity, integrations and support must be agreed before launch.
faq.a5: Not yet. Inbound calls and individually initiated outbound calls are available today. CSV campaigns, automatic queues and retries are clearly marked as coming soon.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: This page explains what the public {domain} website receives and how product-project data is handled.

sections.controllerBody: AI NOW LLC (Georgia, ID 406549070) operates this product website. Privacy questions and rights requests can be sent to CONTACT@aiNOW.GE.
sections.publicSiteBody: If you submit the contact form, the website receives the information entered in that form, primarily your phone number. Hosting infrastructure may also create standard security logs. This landing page does not collect the operational data used inside a future product project.
sections.purposeBody: The contact information is used to answer your request, understand the requested service, protect the website and meet legal obligations. It is not sold.
sections.projectBody: If a project begins, the exact sources, fields, providers, access rights, retention, deletion and human approval rules are written into the proposal, contract or data-processing terms before operational data is connected.
sections.sharingBody: Information may be handled by hosting, communication or technical providers needed to answer the request or operate the agreed service. AI NOW LLC may also disclose information when Georgian law requires it. Product-specific providers are confirmed in the project scope.
sections.retentionBody: Contact and project records are kept only for the business relationship, security and legal periods that apply to them. You can request access, correction or deletion by writing to CONTACT@aiNOW.GE. A legal retention duty may limit deletion.
sections.rightsBody: You may ask what personal data AI NOW LLC holds about you, request correction or deletion, object where applicable, or contact the Personal Data Protection Service of Georgia. Send the request to CONTACT@aiNOW.GE.
sections.changesBody: Material changes are published on this page with a new updated date. The applicable project documents remain part of any active contract.
